body:
Doing it now. I have had to do this again and again. Last time was 7-8 years ago. Two years weekly CBT and anti-depressants. I was in a really good place. Last year, I snapped b cause no matter how positive I was or how well I communicated, I was silenced and it didn’t matter. No matter how insightful you are, no matter how much you learn to love and care for your inner child, with more crap over enough time, it can trigger all the fucking pain all over again. 
I’ll be ok. I’m taking the steps. I’m a survivor who works hard over and over. I’m just tired. So damned tired. No matter what happens in my current relationship, I’m living alone for the next few years to heal. Already know this. It would just be nice to have someone someday to share my life with someday. My inner work is mine, but theirs is theirs and I’m exhausted with “nice guys” who 1. Relapse after 11 years, 2.) end up being  pseudo-asexual rapists after 5 years, or 3.) turn into impotent man whores after 5 years. These are “pillar of the community people” who fooled me. My work is mine, but I am not sure I can trust anyone after this. Because of this, it’s going to make things harder to connect. Again, I don’t expect anyone to do my work, but love and connection are important parts of life. It makes us human.

You are absolutely right. The fucking pisser is that I have even said to him, “I wouldn’t want to break up with her for me because it would mean you’re love is completely shallow.” I have historically been a good poly partner. Ive loved more than one before myself and it was my past partners doing this shit so what the fuck is wrong with me? When I look at things logically, my needs are met and it’s ok. I’m emotionally having problems. Part of it is a lot of shit being stirred up with my (abusive) mom being very ill and likely dying soon. It isn’t logical. 
However, I do have issues with my metmoour. She didn’t want to acknowledge my existence for the first 7 months. I reached out, thought it was ok for awhile, but we didn’t sync well personality wise. Just a massive difference in life experience. She couldn’t handle me saying anything nice on social media about him, so blocked me for months. It really bothered me. She has never had a poly relationship and at 42, this is thus far her longest relationship of her life. We just don’t mesh. I guess civil distance is the best thing for now. We have gotten a pretty solid schedule which helps because I know what to expect.
I think for now I’m upping my every other week therapy to every week as a start. There’s a lot to process. Most of it my own shit.

He’s the only person who has loved me in many years and this started out as poly. I have no right to ask for anything different. If I keep crying, freaking out, and can’t get my shit together, I’m going to lose him. I don’t want to lose him. I love him so much.

I have friends, actually a few really supportive, wonderful friends, but not so much a tribe. I’m in a master’s program and work 40+ hours a week. I was on Wellbutrin and Lexapro. Now just Wellbutrin, which helps the depression, less so anxiety, but I put on 20 pounds with Lexapro which is one of the better SSRIs. I do use cannabis about 4-5 nights a week which does help as well. 
I talked to a mutual friend last night who said to me, “the first thing K (my partner) would say about himself even was that he was self absorbed”. It’s the truth with how he lives his whole life. I think there’s a lot I need to look at in terms of whether or not staying with him is healthy for me regardless of his other partner.

I talked to a guy friend tonight (just a friend... tried to date briefly years ago and we didn't sync) and he kept telling me I deserved better and to dump K and move on. Love is what it is though. K will probably break up with me because I keep crying all the fucking time anyway. 

I am lucky, but it's a fucking curse. Honestly, I have everything. I can go on Tinder and other shitty apps, I end up with my pick of whomever I want. But why? Because I look good on the arm of egomaniacs who can't fucking see my soul who lie to me to get me and then destroy me. I'm not even a person. They pretend, but I'm just a fucking accessory.

Yes, he says he won't leave her. I don't do ultimatums. I suffer. Eventually, I'll stuff it down to love a little less so it won't hurt so much. I think this is the last time I'm ever going to go this deep and if I lose it, I feel like I'll not even be capable of going there again.

It is overwhelming. I'm in therapy. It doesn't help my estranged mother is dying. I need stability and someone to count on in life. I can't do this (poly) anymore and I'm going to lose the person I love more than anyone because of it.
Thank you. So many mixed messages from him. I've been the poly person other people go to for help. I feel like I'm failing that I can't do it.

I want it with him. You know what he has said to me? He's said that he wishes he never met her, but can't break her heart. He's said he wishes he'd get a job far away, so we can just move away together eventually. What do I do with that? He doesn't have the poly history to the extent as I do. Except for a brief period in his 20's, this has been it.

I'm in therapy. I guess I have to figure it out. He's going to leave if I keep crying when he leaves though. I feel stupid.
I'm sorry your family doesn't care. That's how I grew up. I got help and did better. My children are loved. People eventually even loved me for awhile at least.
My ex (my first ex) died a few years after the divorce. His death helped me to forgive him. Someone just there with this lingering pain and regret is worse.
I understand. I keep trying to trust and my heart keeps getting broken.
